EMPTY by default — with no committed ledger public key and no known-good GitHub asset digest, an on-disk release-ledger.json can never be authenticated, so public fails closed (a self-applied "source" label is never trusted). Populate `keys` with PEM public keys keyed by id and reference them from the ledger's `signed_by`, and/or pin known-good GitHub release-asset sha256 per version.
